title: Probabilistic Boolean circuit axioms are complete for Boolean stochastic maps
source_version: Official published CSL2026.29 CC BY4.0 HTML/PDF Theorem11 restated as AppendixB Theorem23, full current normal-form proof and all bearing original circuit PNGs, retrieved2026-10-14

difficulty_reason: The author constructs a unique circuit normal form for each Boolean stochastic map: sorted positive finite probability sums become weighted probabilistic trees, arbitrary input bits are represented by recursive case distinctions, and each generator composition is normalized by moving through if-gates and reducing/reordering the resulting leaf distributions. All probabilistic-choice axioms, semantic interpretation and full author normalization proof with bearing circuit diagrams remain. This non-routine algebraic normal-form construction supports H2 as one equational-completeness theorem, not separate normalization/distribution/image claims.
